title: O Maior Brasileiro de Todos os Tempos

overview: The irresistible romance between a civil servant who obtains a forbidden book that was thoroughly sealed 300 years ago and a popular lawyer who becomes a victim of the forbidden book.
title: Destined with You

overview: In Flippin' RVs, follow husband and wife team Justin and Anna Scribner as they crisscross the country seeking out vintage RVs and trailers to transform into luxury homes on wheels. They'll search through trailer graveyards to find a hidden gem that has been put out to RV pasture, then haul it back to their shop in Bend, Oregon to give it a full overall. And when Justin and Anna restore these RVs to even better than their former glory, you won't believe your eyes.
title: Flippin' RVs

overview: A county party secretary Mei Xiaoge attempts to introduce reforms that he and his colleagues believe needs to be enacted to bring about much needed change and development to the lives of the people of Guangming county.
title: Bright Future

overview: At the peak of their successful careers as content creators, Calle and Poché return to Colombia to reunite with their families, their group of friends, and confront the challenges of their romantic relationship combined with their individual ambitions.
title: Calle y Poché: Sin Etiquetas

overview: Escorpión Dorado and Facundo end their rivalry and sign a contract committing to compete in ten extreme challenges designed by their celebrity friends, who want to see them suffer. Road tripping, competing, earning money, and being punished is the only way to prove who's the real god and who's the mere mortal.
title: Jalas o Te Rajas

overview: Keep up with the KV and her very own royal family. The Drag Race winner is on a wild journey as she puts on the biggest show of her career. Can the queens handle the pressure?
title: Keeping up with Krystal Versace

overview: Small but perfectly formed - short films showcasing fresh talent and famous faces as you've never seen them before. Sitcoms, sketches and silliness.
title: BBC Comedy Short Films

overview: In this followup to "Double Fine Adventure!", 2 Player Productions chronicles the creation of the award winning videogame Psychonauts 2 across seven years of time.
title: Double Fine PsychOdyssey

overview: Winning the lottery is the ultimate dream come true. Everybody fantasizes about winning the big prize and living life without a worry in the world. It comes with all sorts of boons: a private jet, trips around the world, and your own soccer team. The problem is that there is the fantasy, and then there is reality, and "nary the twain shall meet." Actually, most lottery winners lose all their money within just a few years of when they first won it. Some of them become addicts – to gambling or drugs. Some get tangled up in the gray market, while some get into all sorts of fights with their families. The actual winners talk about a radical shift in their lives – one that is too much for them to handle. They say they would rather go back to the way things were, before they won all that money.
title: Six Zeros

overview: Living history show presented by Fi Glover. Six celebrities travel back in time to the relentless graft of Victorian Britain.
title: 24 Hours in the Past

overview: Meet the students and teachers of the Royal Irish Academy of Music in a new 3-part observational documentary series following the academy during a pivotal year in its 175 year history.
title: Face the Music

overview: After the devastating cancellation of their hit show, "Destination Fear", Dakota, Chelsea, Tanner, and Alex rule out the option of ending their terrifying road trips and continue their paranormal investigations by uncovering some of the most haunted places in all of America and the world.
title: Project Fear

overview: Will they be able to Tie the Knot? or Not? Briggs is a simple guy who never got a chance to fall in love because of his responsibilities in their bridal car business, then love finally struck when he met Shao. The problem is Shao is set to be wed with Louise because of an arranged marriage. Tie The Not is a story of sexual awakening and acceptance. It will teach you that true love is how we define it. That it is never too late to fall in love, and that true love is worth fighting for.
title: Tie the Not

overview: Between 1954 and 1966, in a desert area of Fuerteventura, there was a Francoist concentration camp known by the euphemistic name of Colonia Agrícola Penitenciaria de Tefía, one of many places where the regime sent those condemned by the law as vagrants and thugs who, from 1954, it was implemented to also include homosexuals.
title: Las noches de Tefía

overview: Artists perform the albums they believe made them and talk to Jo Whiley about influences, creative process and legacy.
title: Greatest Albums Live

overview: The corrupt and demagogue Odorico Paraguaçu is a candidate for mayor of Sucupira and is elected with the slogan "Vote for a serious man and win a cemetery". The problem is that no one dies for the work to be inaugurated. The mayor decides to consent to the return of the killer Zeca Diabo to the city, with the guarantee that he will not be arrested. There is the hope that he will kill someone and get him a corpse. The mayor just didn't imagine that Zeca Diabo would return to Sucupira ready to never kill anyone again, because he wants to become a righteous man. Odorico has as allies the Cajazeiras sisters, in love with the colonel, and Dirceu Borboleta, his faithful personal secretary.
title: O Bem-Amado

overview: Lin Wan and Lu Xun were as different as two people could be. She was a very witty girl while he was the totally cold CEO bully. Somewhere in their getting to know each other, it turned into love through a tug of war confession. But are they really meant to be?
title: Confess Your Love

overview: In this epic spectacular, the BBC Natural History Unit use a brand new approach to delve deep into the natural world and explore its most critical dimension - time. 24 Hours on Earth travels moment by moment through a virtual day and celebrates the most extraordinary and spectacular examples of how animals and plants are adapted to exploit the 24-hour cycle.
title: 24 Hours on Earth

overview: Seasoned adventurer, author and historian, Professor Bettany Hughes, alongside local experts and academics, takes viewers through her curated selection of Indian treasures. Travelling through this diverse country from North to South, through stunning countryside and spectacular cities, she discovers the fascinating past of this epically beautiful sub-continent. Bettany journeys through temples and palaces, exploring the latest finds in vast archaeological sites, immersing herself in local festivals and traditions, to reveal the histories and traditions that make India unique.
title: Exploring India with Bettany Hughes

overview: After a young woman gives birth to twins and dies, her cold-hearted mother keeps her grandson but rejects his sister with Down syndrome, who is adopted by their sweet-hearted surgeon.
title: Páginas da Vida

overview: After solving the complex and brutal murder of a judge, Israeli Police forensics officer Atlas suffers a complete breakdown. Homeless, he lives rough on the streets of Tel Aviv, alone and cut off from friends, family and society… until the day his past catches up with him. Atlas begins a feverish re-examination of the circumstances surrounding his last case, and embarks on a hunt for the real murderer. Joined on his quest by young prosecutor Dita Hispin, he soon finds himself facing the harshest of dilemmas: is the truth worth the price of its revelation? And can the pursuit of justice make amends for the crimes of the past?
title: Ikaron HaHachlafa

overview: After her marriage breaks up, Susan Hughes leaves Boston, Massachusetts for Los Angeles, California, where her matchmaking sister Victoria lives. Susan gets a job at a spa run by the eccentric but fit, Milt D'Angelo, with Coral, a fellow instructor. Her apartment comes with the obligatory wacky neighbor Leonard Scribner.
title: Just Friends

overview: The Mega-Brands That Built America is the newest series in History's "That Built" franchise, telling the origin stories of some of the most successful businesses in history: from mega-stores like Costco and Walmart to sporting goods giants like Spalding and Wilson, titans like Ivory Soap, Schick and Gillette, to shipping giants like Fedex and UPS, and countless more of the biggest brand names in history. Each story is told through the "That Built" franchises' signature blend of expert interviews and archival, mixed with original premium recreations. Through the eyes of the visionaries and entrepreneurs behind the brands, the series takes viewers on a journey; starting with how it all began, following the innovations, the failures, and all the incredible achievements that forever changed the way Americans live. It's everything you didn't know about the colossal brands you know so well.
title: The Mega-Brands That Built America

overview: Gabriel Menck, GATE's expert negotiator, returns to work after months away. In addition to dealing with the trauma of his wife's death and his son's silence, he will have to face professional challenges, a former vengeful superior and being the prime suspect in his wife's death.
title: Negociador

overview: Dive into the John Wick universe: analyze spectacular action scenes, count shots in all parts, and answer the question of what creative path the lead actor Keanu Reeves took.
title: Джон Уик: Экстра

overview: Sweet and hilarious journey between the patriarch Duan Ruo Rou and the consortium's heir Lu Ao Tian, who accidentally became the "Son-in-Law" in Yunnan's semi-primitive tribe Huacheng.
title: My Matrilocal Husband

overview: Ira is a wayward 30-year-old Muscovite who does not recognize the rules and foundations of modern society. Throughout the season, she easily breaks the fourth wall and openly discusses with the viewer everything that worries her. Topics for reflection and introspection are completely different: from mortgages and a night run to the refrigerator to cleaning the apartment and the impact of female pads on the fur seal population. And okay cats. In Ira's personal life, too, not everything is in order. She meets with the hysterical screenwriter Sergei, but the explosive nature of the woman does not allow them to be together all the time, so the couple quarrels regularly.
title: Ира

overview: This compelling series deconstructs and examines a selection of Ireland's most shocking killings, which in turn sparked some of the county's most infamous murder trials.
title: 24 Hours to Kill

overview: Bongomia is a country that no one cares about, in a history that no one cares about. After the sudden and suspicious death of Thun, king of Bongomia, a complicated story begins when the Prince, whom no one takes seriously and whose family does not even bother to name, comes to the throne.
title: Prens

overview: Marianna, an architecture student, returns from a scholarship in the USA to her family home in Wrocław. Marianna comes to Poland with her fiancé Paul, whose family has Polish roots and who decided to visit their homeland in the former Kresy.
title: Dom pod Dwoma Orlami

overview: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun is often troubled by nightmares. He then gets embroiled in a plagiarism scandal, so he moves to a small village for the time being as he also wants to relax. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong. In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life. And she only wants to track down her crush Kuk Hang-wan from yesteryear. Yat-chun agrees to help as he wants to assist Lau-fong in fulfilling her wish. While they get along, a human and a ghost support each other, and they gradually fall in love. However, someone finds out about Lau-fong's ghost. They are afraid of the truth behind her death being exposed, so they decide to cover up everything at all costs.
title: Unchained Medley

overview: The trajectory of Maria da Graça Xuxa Meneghel and how she conquered Brazil and became the Queen of the Baixinhos.
title: Xuxa, o Documentário

overview: Coverage of women's T20 cricket fixtures.
title: Women's T20 Cricket

overview: Lin Yicheng came from a poor background and became a TV reporter as he wished after graduation. He was gradually and conscientiously the backbone of the television network team. He has certain principles and bottom lines, and has experienced various stories of youth along the way. He is very polite and responsible with a strong sense of self-esteem. Wang Ran, a high-IQ woman, a gold-digger, but also a self-made professional elite, was born into a poor family. Under her beautiful appearance, she is good at relying on beauty to obtain resources for herself and help her friends tear off the 'mask of men'. In Lin Yicheng's journey of mutual encouragement and understanding Wang Ran, love creeps up quietly, but facing reality, he can only endure the pressure of life patiently and enjoy it. Also, because of Lin Yicheng's dedication and understanding to Wang Ran's life and work, she was deeply touched, but she was entangled between reality and ambitions.
title: Ten Years

overview: Toni, Érika, Luna and Walter are close friends, but they don't know each other in person. They only follow each other on a social network that, for them, is as real as life itself.
title: Red Flags

overview: Petter moves into one of the most notorious apartment buildings in Oslo. Who are the people who live here that no one wants to live?
title: Petter – der ingen vil bo

overview: NASCAR Victory Lane is a post-race show for NASCAR Sprint Cup Series events. The program is broadcast on Fox Sports 1 and is hosted by John Roberts or Chris Myers. It also stars Michael Waltrip, Kenny Wallace, Wendy Venturini and Bob Dillner who analyzes the day's event with highlights, post-race interviews and interaction with the winning driver and crew chief.
title: NASCAR Victory Lane

overview: Sagara Ryosuke is an ordinary salaryman and he works for a mid-size shipping company. He is a good natured person. His family consists of his wife Maho, high school student daughter and elementary school student son. Maho works part-time at a supermarket. They are a happy family, but, Maho and their two children suddenly disappear. There are no clues about their disappearance. Ryosuke gets the attention of the media and public. He tries to find the truth behind his family's disappearance with the help of his subordinate Ninomiya Mizuho at work.
title: Guilty Flag

overview: The story revolves around Joseph, an introverted English archaeologist of Greek descent who returns to Greece to take a consulting position on an excavation. Only the foundations on which he has built his life prove to be shaky. He will wander in Crete on a fascinating and dynamic journey into the inner world of his soul.
title: Kart postal

overview: Follows the life of the three members of "Los Prisioneros" during key moments of their careers. As they become an iconic band, and still today resonate.
title: Los Prisioneros

overview: Follows a young, ambitious banker who desperately needed to cure his ailing father and restore his self-worth. He started stealing 1 cent from other people's bank accounts.
title: One Cent Thief

overview: Dissects and x-rays the most spectacular architectural spaces and monuments in Spain to better understand its history and its curiosities.
title: Los pilares del tiempo

overview: Reviews a historic year for Atlético de Madrid until they became league champions. Told from the inside with unpublished images and the testimony of the protagonists. It will have the special participation of Leiva and Joaquín Sabina to attend the birth of the song 'Partido a Partido'.
title: Otra forma de entender la vida: siente lo que somos

overview: Mia nyhta tou Avgoustou is a series that tells the tragic aftermath of a femicide. Prisons of all kinds that people build around them. But also the need for redemption, hope, love, which is inevitably always born from ashes.
title: Mia nyhta tou Avgoustou

overview: Big truck restorer Jon Kelly dices with financial disaster, sky high ambitions, mechanical dramas and his own red-hot personality, as he sets out on an all or nothing mission to build Australia's greatest truck rehab business.
title: Aussie Truck Rehab

overview: Documentary series in which former diplomat Jan Stocklassa investigates the assassination of prime minister of Sweden Olof Palme in 1986 using the personal files of Stieg Larsson, the author of The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo trilogy.
title: The Man Who Played with Fire

overview: The daily work and personal lives of a busy company which employs six young women is examined.
title: WorkinGirls

overview: Ten books, ten municipalities, ten women directors, ten TV-movies. The same universe: Told by Women. Comedy, romance, adventure, historical dramas, narrative content by great Portuguese-speaking writers and the vision of ten women directors from different generations and different creative backgrounds who portray a country that, in the last 100 years, finds itself towards freedom.
title: Contado por Mulheres

overview: What do you get when you mix a granddaughter from an extremely rich family with crime, murder, and a passion for law and justice? Kanbe Miwako, a granddaughter of a super rich millionaire becomes a detective and starts working at a male dominant police station. Her fancy fashion, elegant manners, and upper-class attitudes constantly gets on the nerves of the old-fashioned coworkers. However, to everyone's surprise, Miwako's unique investigation lead by an ultra rich sense of value becomes the key to solve mysterious cases, one by one!
title: Fugo Keiji

overview: In early 1980s a young child disappears. The lack of police support pushes the concerned parents to take justice into their own hands and launch a desperate manhunt that is seen from the perspective of the local children.
title: Munkkivuori

overview: When Brooke blindsides Blake and ends their two year relationship, Blake doesn't hesitate before jumping back into the New York dating scene.
title: Makeup X Breakup

overview: The identity of the serial killer known as 'The Zodiac' has been confounding investigators for nearly fifty years, but an unlikely and unconventional theorist may have finally shed light to America's most famous cold case by asking a question that no one else has ever dared ask: what if the reason the Zodiac has never been caught...is because he never existed in the first place?
title: Myth of the Zodiac Killer

overview: In Canada, the world of professional hockey is a source of fascination and admiration. Who are these heroes acclaimed by enthralled crowds capable of exploits that will be talked about for years? What is really happening on the ice during games? What is being said? What does it mean to be a professional athlete on a daily basis? Who are these players? How do the bosses manage it all? And what does the general manager and his men discuss before and aftergames?
title: 24CH

overview: Superpowered: The DC Story takes an unprecedented look at the enduring and influential legacy of DC, allowing fans to rediscover the universe of characters, as well as the iconic comic book company's origins, its evolution and its nearly nine-decade cultural impact across every artistic medium. Featuring a wealth of interviews with the industry's most prolific creators and the actors who bring their iconic characters from the page to the screen, Superpowered: The DC Story reminds us that at the heart of DC are the comics – the four-color fantasies that forever spark the imagination and instill hope.
title: Superpowered: The DC Story

overview: The Next Black Millionaires takes a deep dive into the entrepreneurs' journeys as they overcome obstacles, navigate relationships, and scale their businesses, all while leaning on the community around them. The Next Black Millionaires, a docuseries that captures the journey of three ambitious entrepreneurs growing their passions into million-dollar businesses.
title: The Next Black Millionaires

overview: An inside look back at the greatest geek year in cinema ever, 1982, with stars, directors, writers, producers, critics and pop culture historians sharing their insights about such classic films as "E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial," "Blade Runner," "Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan," "Poltergeist," "Tron," and many more. Filled with exclusive interviews, rare behind-the-scenes footage and incredible never-before-seen clips in a fun, lively, no-holds-barred celebration of the legendary moviegoing year, Greatest Geek Year Ever: 1982 takes viewers behind-the-scenes of the biggest and most influential movies ever made at a time when fandom was in its infancy.
title: Greatest Geek Year Ever: 1982

overview: Burb Patrol follows the workplace adventures of Randall, an uncompromising by-the-book security guard and his partner Alex, an unmotivated slacker as the duo keeps the members of a gated suburban community safe against a slew of first-world problems.
title: Burb Patrol

overview: Reality show in which we can see well-known celebrities working at the airport.
title: Sztárok a reptéren

overview: The most chaotic story of "servant gangs" from two high society houses that were hired to match their own masters. The obstacle is the fact that both houses have hated each other for generations.
title: A Match by Maid

overview: In The Stolen Girl, a seemingly ordinary decision turns the world of Elisa, mum to two young kids, upside down. When Elisa's nine-year-old daughter asks to go on an overnight playdate with her new best friend, Elisa agrees. But when she says goodnight to her daughter, she has no idea that she is about to be thrust into every parent's worst nightmare, and when Elisa goes to pick her up, she discovers that the beautiful house was a holiday rental, while her daughter has disappeared. What follows is a manhunt across Europe, while Elisa and husband Fred find themselves the object of police scrutiny.
title: The Stolen Girl

overview: A team of six policemen led by Sub-Inspector Manoj is on a chase to solve a murder in a suburban lodge room, with just one clue - a fake address, Shiju, Parayil Veedu, Neendakara, from a lodge register.
title: Kerala Crime Files

overview: A mockumentary series that follows a rag-tag trio of clueless security officers and their boisterous supervisor as they struggle to keep their jobs.
title: Bouncers

overview: Celebrities, eyewitnesses and pop culture pundits relive the most memorable moments of the decade that ushered in the new millennium. From Y2K to Weird Al Yankovic, Tupac to "Titanic," and Madonna to the Macarena, Rewind the '90s explores the forces that shaped the decade that changed the world forever.
title: Rewind the '90s

overview: Surf Girls: International follows five upcoming female surfers as they compete in the Challenger Series. They travel all over the world, representing their home countries while striving to get on the World Surf Tour. To develop as surfers they must overcome their own personal struggles, and deal with the challenges of the international spotlight.
title: Surf Girls

overview: Actor and adventure enthusiast Orlando Bloom embarks on a physical, mental and spiritual journey of self-discovery as he undertakes learning three extreme sports -- wingsuiting, free diving and rock climbing -- to push himself to the edge of what is possible. With family, friends and his spiritual Buddhist practice guiding the way, Orlando is trained by experts who help him overcome obstacles, face his fears and discover valuable lessons about himself.
title: Orlando Bloom: To the Edge

overview: Hairspray. Spandex. Leather pants. I Wanna Rock: The ‘80s Metal Dream follows five young dreamers chasing stardom in the cutthroat world of '80s metal. Some will succeed, some will fail, but each will make you see an entirely new side of the metal genre.
title: I Wanna Rock: The ‘80s Metal Dream

overview: Primos TRUTH About Hunting returns for its 17th season in 2017 as an Outdoor Channel fan favorite. Join Will Primos, Jimmy Primos, Brad Farris and friends as they chase turkey, elk, deer, waterfowl, and predators from hunting camps in Mississippi, Louisiana, and Arkansas to points all over North America. As ever, the TRUTH is about hunters who are serious about their sport and serious about wildlife conservation, but who also value family, friendship, and fun. If you're looking for phony drama or scripted stories, look elsewhere, because like Will always says, "This ain't Hollywood. This is the TRUTH!"
title: Primos TRUTH About Hunting

overview: Ekaterina and Sergey live a prosperous life as a married couple "with experience": family breakfasts and dinners, housekeeping - a routine, and nothing more. An outlet for Katya was work. She teaches piano at a children's music school and works, as they say, not for money, but at the call of her soul. Katya is trying to bring at least some variety into her life, in particular in her relationship with Sergei. Turns out she's embarrassed. And Sergey is satisfied with everything as usual, and he does not notice what is happening with his wife. To top it off, Katya is fired from her job and has a nervous breakdown. Sergei, seriously concerned about his wife's condition, takes a vacation at his own expense, buys tickets to a seaside resort and takes his family to the city of his childhood. However, a family vacation on a "last minute" breaks the measured course of their lives and is fraught with many surprises.
title: Солнце, море и любовь

overview: Juliana and Fernanda are best friends, but they feel that they arouse something stronger than friendship. To face the fear of assuming what they feel, they find in the friend Daniel the support and help necessary to live this feeling.
title: A Melhor Amiga da Noiva

overview: Twilight tells the story of Liu Xia using psychological knowledge to save a suicide girl, which was witnessed by Qilian Shan, who wanted to adapt his psychological novel into a script and invited her to be a consultant. The two got closer and closer in their joint cooperation, and while they succeeded in their careers, they also reaped a beautiful love story.
title: Twilight

overview: Set in an idyllic English town, Beth Fairchild has prepared a surprise birthday party for her husband Tom. With most of the village present as Tom is the beloved local doctor, Beth's world is turned upside down when the party is interrupted by the police and Tom is arrested for murder. Beth believes her husband has been wrongly accused but she soon makes some shocking discoveries that cast doubt on his innocence, and she confides her worries in Adam, Tom's best friend from childhood.
title: The Serial Killer's Wife

overview: Follows three women on their quest to find love as they attempt to uncover who are the "nice guys" looking for love, and who are the self-proclaimed "FBoys".
title: FBOY Island Australia

overview: Yaz Şarkısı tells the story of Yaz, who clings to her father's dream and tries to make it come true in Istanbul, where she came to study.
title: Yaz Şarkısı

overview: Nikolaj Lie Kaas' comedy drama series about Joe, who works as an agent for stars in the entertainment industry. But it's not going quite as well as it could.
title: Agent

overview: "No matter how much time we spend together, I'll never become special to you." Childhood best friends. Two halves of a whole. The cool, smart one who's good at almost everything, and his average, dorky friend who struggles to do anything right­—Yamato and Kakeru. Always by the other's side, but not together in the way they truly want to be. No matter how hard they try, their hearts cannot reach each other...
title: Kimi ni wa Todokanai

overview: Thousands audition. Only one can win. The search is on for the next singing Superstar. The X Factor is a talent show in which the participants have to audition before a jury.
title: The X Factor

overview: "Fight to Survive" tells the inspiring true stories of outdoorsmen who have faced down death in the wilderness and lived to tell their story. Adventurer, author and survivor Craig DeMartino kicks off the series with his own story. His hundred-foot free fall off of a granite cliff in Colorado cost him a leg and almost his life, but did not stop him from pursuing his passion for the outdoors.In 2006 he became the first amputee to free climb the nearly 10,000 ft. face of Yosemite's El Capitan in a single day. Now Craig hosts Fight to Survive, journeying to meet other survivors and hear their stories. Each week Craig takes a survivor back to the flashpoint of their ordeal as they share with him their very own fight to survive. This new series takes the audience right into to some of the most majestic and dangerous places in North America. From the exciting action to the inspiring comebacks, these stories will remind us all that faith, determination and human spirit can do anything when faced with the ultimate Fight to Survive.
title: Fight to Survive

overview: In this satirical docuseries, experts and former followers examine the lives of six infamous cult leaders.
title: How to Become a Cult Leader

overview: The Floor is a physical quiz show that sees 81 contestants face off in quiz duels on a giant LED floor divided into a 9×9 grid of squares, each representing its own field of knowledge. The first challenger, selected at random, must choose one of his or her neighboring opponents to go head-to-head in an epic quiz duel in the opponent's category. The winner takes over the loser's square, gaining valuable ground as they expand their territory, while the loser exits the game. The winner must then choose – do they continue on and attempt to secure another square? Or do they let The Floor choose a new challenger? The last contestant standing who gains full control over The Floor takes home a life-changing $250,000 cash prize.
title: The Floor

overview: Fanny Legoff returns to Brocéliande University from Paris after 15 years in Paris after leaving under suspicion she was involved in the disappearance of her friend Laura.
title: Brocéliande

overview: Hub Halloran, a murdered bounty hunter, is back from the dead after being resurrected by the Devil to trap and send back demons that have escaped from the prison of Hell. By chasing down those demons with the help and hindrance of his estranged family, Hub learns how his own sins got his soul condemned -- which pushes him to seek a second chance at life, love, and country music.
title: The Bondsman

overview: On a winding road in the Pyrenees, a spectacular car accident turns out to be miraculous: the reappearance of Anna, a teenager who disappeared 5 years ago. Captain Alix Stern and Commissioner Balthus are deployed alongside Victor Ferrer, the head of the local gendarmerie, to embark on a race against time. Find the trace of Lucie, a young girl kidnapped at the same time as Anna and who has not reappeared...
title: Rivière perdue

overview: Guy Fieri brings together eight of the most renowned chefs in the culinary world to compete in the Flavortown Market for the very first time on Guy's Grocery Games: All-Star Invitational. Each week the chefs go head-to-head to see whose shopping and cooking skills are a cut above the rest. They must navigate their way through the grocery aisles as they are tested in challenges from "Express Lane," where they must create a signature sandwich and side using only 8 ingredients, to "Budget Battle," where they must make an impressive weeknight dinner for four with only $25, to "Frozen Food Feud," where they must make a dish only using frozen ingredients, and many more. Ultimately, the food does the talking, as a rotating panel of judges determine who checks out of the competition.
title: Guy's Grocery Games: All-Star Invitational

overview: Relaxed pacifist, matcha'addict and convinced vegan, Panda runs a small hut in a remote corner of the Camargue. No laptop, no computer, no car, he lives with his 16-year-old teenager in this perfect cocoon of peace and serenity. Alas, even in paradise, there's no way to be quiet. The day his old life comes knocking at the door, Panda finds himself forced to return to service... But in his own way. Zen, what.
title: Panda

overview: The Jackie Bushman Show is a new concept in outdoors entertainment. This program features some of the most intense hunting footage shot in North America, but, unlike other shows, it doesn't end with the hunt. Jackie hosts interviews with various celebrities and his crew to discuss great hunting moments that have defined Buckmasters since it exploded onto American TV screens in 1988.
title: The Jackie Bushman Show

overview: Joanna Lumley sets off on one of her most epic voyages yet, a journey through the world's greatest spice continents to discover the rich tapestry of flavours and cultures which have shaped our world. Touring Indonesia, Zanzibar, India and Madagascar, Joanna explores the centuries-old spice trade in this brand new four-part series of discovery.
title: Joanna Lumley's Spice Trail Adventure

overview: While in the first part, Lili searched for her mother, she now questions her mom on the identity of her father.
title: Lace II

overview: Mikhail Aleksandrovich Nefedov, a genius mathematician, teaches probability theory and mathematical statistics at the university. He remembers everything he has ever heard, seen or read. Mikhail learns that his teenage son has a dangerous genetic disease, the treatment of which will require a multimillion-dollar sum. Having sold the apartment, Nefedov makes a perfectly calculated bet on a local football league match, but ... loses. He couldn't have made a mistake, which means there is an unaccounted variable in the equation. And this is an underground betting business, where the results of games are rigged to extract illegal income. Mikhail calculates the organizers of the shadow business and demands his winnings from them. So begins the war of a university teacher with the betting mafia. Devoid of emotions, attachments and fear, a genius will not save himself from anything… But one day he will find himself a man — vulnerable, dependent and truly alive.
title: Теория больших денег

overview: 3 is a new relationship series in which three single women of different ages, life experiences and backgrounds meet for the first time with a common goal - to find true love. During their journey, the women meet nearly 100 men before they begin to narrow down their suitors to find their perfect partner. As they search for love, they share their lives and emotionally support one another during the dating and decision-making process.
